firstPrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one high-quality photorealistic 3D-rendered studio product image for PSL Labs website, square 1024x1024. The supplied image is the exact packaging identity reference. Keep the same clear glass vial proportions, brushed silver cap, dark stopper, cyan brand band, PSL Labs white DNA mark, iridescent silver label, product name Retatrutide, 10MG, and RESEARCH USE ONLY. Preserve accurate readable label typography. Do not add any claims, certification badges, additional products, or medical props. Use a front three-quarter camera, gently tilted vial only about 12 degrees to the left, with the full vial visible centered at consistent scale, top at 15% and bottom at 78% of image height. Float vial a little above a low charcoal cylindrical display plinth at the bottom. Near-black charcoal studio background #10171c, soft cyan rim light from right, white softbox reflections on clear glass and brushed metal, physically convincing glass edge/refraction, soft realistic shadow under vial. Sophisticated restrained custom scientific brand aesthetic. No infographic, no surrounding text, no decorative molecules, no sparks. This is an illustrative product render, not a photograph.
